summary: data area (chosen per app: --opt flash_area=...) of the 64 MB S25HS512T QSPI NOR on SMIF0: read/erase(256 KB)/write, XIP read pointer
source: https://github.com/Infineon/mtb-example-psoc-edge-serial-flash-readwrite (mtb_serial_memory_*); offsets surveyed 2026-10-10: littlefs CE + emFile NOR config 0x00A00000, serial-flash CE 0x01F80000, OTA CEs use the BSP MCUboot slots, secure-smif-access CE a memory-configurator region
notes: SMIF0 also runs XIP for all images: never claim SMIF0 itself; erase/program routines run from RAM; the area is a compile-time define (extflash.h #errors without it)

flash_area.question: Which area of the 64 MB QSPI NOR may this app erase/write for data?

fs-10mb.label: 0x00A00000 + 4 MB - Infineon default for file systems (mtb-example-psoc-edge-filesystem-littlefs-freertos FS_STORAGE_START_ADDRESS, emfile FS_ConfigNOR_BM_SPIFI.c FLASH_START_ADDR)

ce-test-sectors.label: 0x01F80000 + 512 KB - the two sectors mtb-example-psoc-edge-serial-flash-readwrite erases (memSize/2 - 2 x eraseSize)

top-16mb.label: 0x03000000 + 16 MB - top quarter of the chip, furthest from the BSP image regions

custom.why: 256 KB aligned, above the BSP 1.4.0 image regions (end 0x00880000), inside 64 MB
